Rig asset prep

Leg polygon cutter

Trace each leg's real outline instead of a bounding rectangle, so the cut body layer doesn't leave a rectangular notch at the shoulder/hip. Switch animals with the tabs below — the yellow lizard's already-traced legs show as a dashed starting guide on the other two, since their poses are close but not pixel-identical. When you're done, export the JSON and paste it back into the chat.

Click: add point · drag a point: move it · right-click a point: delete it x: —, y: —

How to use it

  1. Pick an animal tab (top), then a leg below it, then click around the image to trace its outline, vertex by vertex.
  2. On the green/red tabs, the dashed outline is the yellow lizard's already-traced shape — a starting point, not a perfect fit. Trace over/around it rather than accepting it as-is.
  3. Close the shape by double-clicking, or clicking back on its first point.
  4. Clicked in the wrong spot? Drag any point (even after closing) to reposition it, or right-click a point to delete it outright.
  5. While still placing points, Backspace undoes just the last one · Esc clears the whole in-progress shape.
  6. Repeat for all four legs on both green and red, then export once — it bundles every animal into one JSON.
